title: Vacation Leave Policy
content: Vacation leave is granted to full-time employees. The yearly allowance is 25 paid days. Employees should request leave in advance and coordinate with their manager to protect team coverage.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: Remote work is allowed for eligible roles. Employees can work remotely up to three days each week with prior manager approval. Teams must ensure office coverage, secure access, and uninterrupted delivery.

title: Sick Leave Policy
content: When an employee is sick, they should notify their manager promptly. Sick leave handling depends on local legal requirements and may require medical documentation for extended absence.

title: Parental Leave Policy
content: Employees expecting a child should contact HR as early as possible to review local legal entitlements, company-paid benefits, documentation requirements, and return-to-work planning.

title: Learning and Development Policy
content: The company supports professional growth through manager-approved courses, certifications, and conferences. Reimbursement depends on budget availability, business relevance, and prior approval.

title: Probation Period Policy
content: The standard probation period is six months unless a local contract states otherwise. Managers provide regular feedback and confirm successful completion at the end of the review period.

title: Overtime Policy
content: Employees should not work overtime regularly without manager approval. Recording, compensation, and time-off-in-lieu rules depend on local legal requirements and employment agreements.
